beats.text: Six classic books short enough to finish in a single weekend.
One. The Metamorphosis — Kafka. A man wakes up as an insect, and his family's love is tested.
Two. A Christmas Carol — Dickens. One night, three ghosts, and a soul worth saving.
Three. Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde — Stevenson. The monster and the gentleman share one body.
Four. Heart of Darkness — Conrad. A river journey into the worst of what people can become.
Five. Antigone — Sophocles. One woman against the state, in under forty pages.
Six. The Great Gatsby — Fitzgerald. The beautiful, hollow heart of the American dream.
Six weekends, six classics. Full retellings of each are on the channel.
